profile.headline: Software Engineer at Facebook
profile.summary: 15 years of industry experience in software development, ranging from working on file system, database, open source technology, to automation and microservices architecture. Passionate about bringing machine learning applications live to make a better world!

positions.title: Lead Services and Integration Engineer - IBM Watson Health
positions.description:
•	Integrated open source technologies around machine learning algorithms that derive insights from HL7 patient data and radiology DICOM images and designed end-to-end solutions in microservices architecture.
•	Strategized multi-tenancy deployment via Kubernetes to scale containerized clinical applications in a HIPAA compliant private cloud. 
•	Advocated and prototyped data modeling in Apache Cassandra to improve analytics performance using Apache Spark dataset API on Apache Zeppelin notebook.
•	Containerized Spring/Spring Boot applications on WebSphere Liberty Profile in a CI/CD development environment. 
•	Automated via Ansible scripts to simplify administrative tasks to onboard/offboard tenants and modify configurations.
•	Established secured site-to-site communications via SSL/TLS 1.2 between Nifi instances.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - IBM Spark Technology Center
positions.description:
•	Delivered Openstack Swift object storage connector to Apache Spark that allows efficient data transfer to IBM Softlayer cloud. 
•	Contributed JIRA fixes to Apache Spark in the areas of pySpark, machine learning, graphX, and dataframe.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - IBM z/OS
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, and implemented a high priority DB2 capacity feature that raises the maximum partition size for universal tablespace to 1TB. 
•	Delivered as a lead developer a major mainframe file system feature that enables record level sharing for catalogs to improve scalability for large batch processing.
•	Advocated for quality improvement through the use of random error injections in the system test environment to uncover hidden timing-related problems and recovery issues.
•	Initiated the design talk to support multiple scalable buffer pools and prototyped the high level design to support forward recovery for catalogs.

positions.title: Internship
positions.description:
•	Participated in making design decisions on 64-bit buffering implementation.
•	Propagated updates and fixes in one release into different releases.
